CREATE TABLE VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_01 AS
-- 蚂蚁借呗
SELECT t.orig_prod_no, t.PROD_NO, t.PROD_NAME, t.data_sourc_tab_name, t.loan_bal
FROM C_AGT_ITNET_LOAN_RCPT_INF T
WHERE T.DATA_DT=当日 AND t.data_sourc_tab_name='F_EV_MYLN_DISTR_DTL'
  AND (t.loan_bal<>0 OR REPLACE(t.clear_dt,'-','')>DATE'{年初}') AND NVL(loan_rcpt_sts_cd,'')<>'04'
  AND t.comp_flag<>'1'
UNION ALL
-- 幸福消金
SELECT ... FROM C_AGT_ITNET_LOAN_RCPT_INF T
LEFT JOIN F_AC_CFXF_LOAN_RCPT A ON t.loan_rcpt_no=a.LOAN_ACCT_NO AND 拉链有效
WHERE T.data_sourc_tab_name='F_AC_CFXF_LOAN_RCPT' AND a.BIZ_STS_CD<>'1' AND NVL(t.COMP_FLAG,'0')<>'1'
UNION ALL
-- 电子账户、小企业、小企业众商贷等...

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 分户账余额提取（按产品分类标签）
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
CREATE TABLE VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_02 AS
SELECT CASE WHEN acct_no IN(...) THEN '01-众安贷' WHEN acct_cn_name LIKE '%微粒贷%' THEN '02-微粒贷' ... ELSE acct_no END LB,
  SUM(DEBTOR_BAL - creditor_bal) debtor_bal
FROM fdm.F_AC_CRBS_SUB_LDGR T
WHERE start_dt<=当日 AND end_dt>当日
  AND (账务机构号3-4位 IN ('92','96') OR 指定账号列表 OR 幸福消金特定账号)
  AND T.subj_no LIKE '13%' AND T.SUBJ_NO NOT LIKE '1320%'
GROUP BY LB
UNION ALL
SELECT '00-总和' LB, SUM(DEBTOR_BAL - creditor_bal)
FROM fdm.F_AC_CRBS_SUB_LDGR T WHERE (相同条件)
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: 从ODM.O_CRBS_ANBFH按复杂规则分类标签提取分户账余额（DEBTOR_BAL-creditor_bal），分类标签包括01-众安贷、02-微粒贷...00-总和等

knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
-- SETP2: 共性余额分类
CREATE TABLE VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_03 AS
SELECT CASE WHEN DATA_SOURC_TAB_NAME IN('F_AC_UPEA_STAGES_INF') AND ORIG_PROD_NO IN('1078') THEN '01-众安贷'
  WHEN ORIG_PROD_NO IN('1005','1007','2005') THEN '02-微粒贷' ... END AS FLG,
  SUM(TT.LOAN_BAL) LOAN_BAL FROM VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_01 TT GROUP BY FLG
UNION ALL SELECT '00-总和' FLG, SUM(TT.LOAN_BAL) FROM VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_01 TT;

-- SETP3: 共性VS分户对比入表
INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_TB_CHECK
SELECT '40003', '共性互联网贷款与分户账余额核对', LEFT(T1.FLG,2), T1.FLG,
  T1.LOAN_BAL, NVL(T2.debtor_bal,0),
  CASE WHEN T1.FLG IN('14-如意贷','00-总和') THEN T1.LOAN_BAL-T2.debtor_bal+350 ELSE T1.LOAN_BAL-NVL(T2.debtor_bal,0) END, 当日
FROM VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_03 T1
LEFT JOIN VT_C_FIN_TB_CHECK_ITNET_LOAN_02 T2 ON T1.FLG=T2.LB
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_TB_CHECK
SELECT '40003', '共性互联网贷款与分户账余额核对', LEFT(T1.FLG,2), T1.FLG,
  T1.LOAN_BAL AS dtl_acct_bal, NVL(T2.debtor_bal,0) AS gl_bal,
  CASE WHEN T1.FLG IN('14-如意贷','00-总和') THEN T1.LOAN_BAL-T2.debtor_bal+350 ELSE T1.LOAN_BAL-NVL(T2.debtor_bal,0) END AS margin_val
FROM 共性余额分类表 T1 LEFT JOIN 分户账余额表 T2 ON 分类标签匹配

THEN '08-易鑫' WHEN orig_prod_no IN('1301'...) THEN '09-抖音' WHEN orig_prod_no IN('1401'...) THEN '11-众邦' WHEN orig_prod_no IN('1088','1038'...) THEN '12-太保' WHEN data_sourc_tab_name='F_EV_MYLN_DISTR_DTL' THEN '13-借呗' WHEN data_sourc_tab_name='F_AC_SFLN_LOAN_RCPT_INF' THEN '21-小企业金企贷' WHEN data_sourc_tab_name='F_AC_SPLN_LOAN_RCPT' THEN '22-小企业银保贷' WHEN data_sourc_tab_name='F_AC_SILN_LOAN_RCPT' THEN '23-小企业微业贷' WHEN data_sourc_tab_name IN('F_AC_SCLN_LOAN_BASIC_INF'...)
